Collaborations & Partnerships

My research operates at the highly interdisciplinary intersection of clinical linguistics, speech pathology, and artificial intelligence. Because solving complex neurological challenges requires diverse expertise, my work is built on active, cross-institutional collaborations. I partner with clinicians, computer scientists, and academic institutions worldwide to translate computational theories into impactful clinical tools.

What I Bring to a Collaboration

  • Deep Domain Expertise: Decades of experience in speech, language, and communication pathology, specifically regarding neurodegenerative diseases like Primary Progressive Aphasia (PPA).
  • Computational Infrastructure: Direct access to and integration with Open Brain AI, providing a ready-to-use, scalable architecture for processing and analyzing multimodal clinical speech data.
  • Grant Writing & Strategy: Extensive experience in formulating competitive research proposals and securing joint funding (e.g., Horizon Europe, Research Council of Norway).

Who I Am Looking to Partner With

  • Clinical Researchers & Hospitals: Medical professionals with access to patient cohorts (e.g., dementia, aphasia) who need advanced computational tools to analyze their speech and cognitive data.
  • Machine Learning & NLP Specialists: Computer scientists interested in applying cutting-edge algorithms to real-world, high-impact medical datasets.
  • Consortium Partners: European and international researchers looking to build strong, multidisciplinary teams for major grant applications.

Let's Connect

If you are interested in exploring joint grant applications, sharing data, or utilizing computational language assessment in your clinical trials, I would love to connect. Please reach out with a brief overview of your proposed collaboration.
